title: Clearer mobile map navigation and accurate continent-border answers
body:
MOBILE GAMEPLAY
- Added a high-contrast Back to map button in daily-game and friend-duel notebooks, with English and Polish labels.
- Improved mobile version-label contrast and safe-area placement while keeping desktop controls compact.
- The client version now stays visible when the development server is launched directly.

QUESTION ACCURACY
- Questions about touching or bordering a continent now check land-border neighbors rather than the country's own continent.
- Preserved this distinction in Polish questions, spelling repairs, negation, and compound questions.
- Retired cached country-question plans from the previous planner revision.

Your saved game progress, streaks, and question limits are unchanged.
